article.title: Telegram Widgets Hit by RCE Demos, Malware Warning Days After Launch
article.summary: Kaspersky suspects exploitation of Telegram’s new widgets to deliver WebRAT, as researchers demo RCE and Pavel Durov disputes the claims. The post Telegram Widgets Hit by RCE Demos, Malware Warning Days After Launch appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.relevance_reason: Các chuyên gia vừa đưa ra cảnh báo về khả năng thực thi mã từ xa (RCE) và phát tán mã độc WebRAT thông qua tính năng widget mới ra mắt của Telegram.

article.title: Cursor Supply Chain Attack Started at Fireworks AI
article.summary: The attacker stole an access key from Fireworks and used it to exfiltrate credentials that enabled them to push malicious Claude Code extension copies. The post Cursor Supply Chain Attack Started at Fireworks AI appeared first on SecurityWeek .

items.relevance_reason: Vụ tấn công chuỗi cung ứng bắt nguồn từ Fireworks AI đã dẫn đến việc rò rỉ khóa truy cập và đẩy các tiện ích mở rộng Claude Code giả mạo chứa mã độc đến người dùng.

article.title: Six Unpatched Danfoss Refrigeration Controller Flaws Could Allow Remote Takeover Without Login
article.summary: Six flaws in Danfoss AK-SM800A refrigeration controllers could let a remote attacker take over a controller without logging in, Dutch security consultancy Midnight Blue said earlier this week. No patch is available, and the researchers say the newest firmware, version 5.4.0, does not fix the flaws. article.title: Unpatched GeoVision camera software gave cryptojackers a side door into 13 organizations
article.summary: Attackers used GeoVision camera management software to break into Windows machines at 13 organizations and turn them into cryptocurrency miners, Huntress warned in a threat advisory. GeoVision is a Taiwanese surveillance and access control company with customers in 110 countries. The victims work in various industries, and most of the intrusions happened between November 8 and 10.
